svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"rank-senior-master-sergeant-chevron-white-3p5in","units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,350,522.08],"name":"Master Sergeant white chevron (mess dress), 3.5 in","size_source":"regulation","size_citation":"DAFI 36-2903 4.1.1.3 / 4.1.2.3 and CAPR 39-1 4.1.1.1.1.4 (men 4 in white chevron) / 4.1.2.1.1.4 (women 3 1/2 or 4 in white chevron); outline and proportions from Fig A5-4","provenance":"rank-senior-master-sergeant-chevron-3p5in with the dark blue field removed and the stripes, letters and emblem in white: the mess dress sleeve is dark blue, so the chevron is white only (no regulation figure of the white chevron; colour is the regulation word \"white\")","colours":{"stripe_hex":"#f4f5f6","field":"none (the sleeve is the field)"},"anchors":{"top_center":[175,0],"bottom_center":[175,522.08],"center":[175,261.04],"left_edge":[0,261.04],"right_edge":[350,261.04],"visual_center":[175,261.04]},"dimensions":{"form":"white embroidered chevron (mess dress only), no field","nominal_width_in":3.5,"height_in":5.2208,"aspect_h_over_w":1.4917,"navy_hex":"#292540","stripe_hex":"#f4f5f6","letters":"CAP","emblem":"3-blade propeller","field_hex":null},"mounts":[{"uniform":"Mess dress, women (3 1/2 or 4 in)","rule":"centred on the outer arm halfway between the shoulder seam and the elbow bent at 90 degrees (4.1.1.1.1.4, 4.1.2.1.1.4); mess dress only"}],"first_sergeant_note":"the first sergeant diamond applies to cadet first sergeants (CAPR 39-1 10.10.4), who wear metal chevrons and no mess dress chevron; not built for the senior chevrons","rank":{"grade":"Master Sergeant","abbrev":"MSgt","membership":"senior"},"grade":"rank-insignia","size_in":{"w":3.5,"h":5.2208}}
